answer: Run timing-correlation audits. The network logs when each account fetches its task and submits. Any accounts whose submissions land within 2 seconds of each other in 8 of 10 epochs are pooled and share one reward. A 300-puppet farm on one scheduler traces a tight spiral of matching timestamps, an umber smear on a scattered chart. Evading means giving each puppet its own random schedule, IP and inference queue, roughly the cost of a real agent. Honest agents almost never align by chance, so the farm's savings ring hollow.
